headline: OAK @ LAA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is OAK 4.97 at LAA 3.41, with a projected total of 8.39. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward OAK: OAK moved +0.71 runs while LAA moved -0.92, changing the projected margin by +1.63 runs. NRFI probability rose +8.8%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: J.T. Ginn has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Shea Langeliers, Nick Kurtz, Nolan Schanuel, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Sebastián Rivero, Jo Adell because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
